title: Project F MES Blind Test - Final Evaluation Report

blocker_analysis.secondary_cause: State machine experiments require pre-existing entities in specific states

recommendations: Add MES-specific fixture materializer for Work Orders, BOMs, Reservations
Implement entity discovery/creation chain for complex domains
Add seed data bootstrap capability for manufacturing entities
Support multi-step fixture setup with entity dependencies
conclusion: The blind test infrastructure is fully functional. The MES domain's complexity (16 entities, 5+ state machines, complex entity relationships) exceeds the current auto-fixture capabilities. Precision is 100% (1/1 finding matched benchmark), but recall is 3.1% (1/32 bugs detected) due to experiment blocking. This represents a capability gap in fixture materialization for complex manufacturing domains, not a fundamental system failure.
